printed: State (street with streetcar tracks; 'STATE' printed further south, no label at this spot)
unlabelled E-W street (18" sewer) - continuation of the diagonal 'Wilder Avenue'
note: The diagonal printed 'WILDER AVE.' comes up from the SW, reaches a small triangular block (lots 64/65) at about 5480,3450, and a short unlabelled E-W street (y 3275-3360, 18-inch sewer) runs east from there to State. State has streetcar tracks and bends NE here. I picked where that E-W centreline (y about 3317) meets State's centreline. I took the E-W piece to be today's Wilder because it lines up with the expected point.

Wilder Ave comes up diagonally from the SW (centre about 5450 at y 3607) and forks at the triangular block of lots 64/65. The NNE fork, printed DENVER (house numbers 1100-1200), is taken as today's Neff. The NE fork goes on to the E-W piece that meets State. The pick is the middle of the open fork just south of the island. The geometry is irregular, so precision is about 20-30 px.

No street near the expected point. A railroad corridor with about 6 tracks (no lots or house numbers fronting it, x about 6500-6620) crosses W. Eighth at about 6560,5600. Factory Street runs just east of the tracks (x about 6620-6680) but only between Boston and Whateley; south of Whateley, block 63 runs west to the tracks, so Factory does not reach W. Eighth. W. Eighth's south edge is at the plate's bottom edge.

printed: Avenue (south leg, printed '...AVE.', name beyond region) / Elberon (north leg)
note: Warsaw runs E-W (y 3390-3480, centre about 3436) and has tracks. North of it is Elberon Ave, whose west half is cut by the plate's west edge (white west of x about 258); its east edge is x 300. South of it a street printed '...AVE.' runs from x about 205 to 285, with a 12-inch sewer near x 245; letters '...VER' appear further south at about 225,4320. I took this south leg to be today's Del Monte, but no 'Del Monte' is printed. The crossing sits against the plate's west edge.
Woodrow St (printed WOODROW; the old Berlin St), x 7252-7327, runs south from Gest and ends at South St (y about 4772-4850; the blue boundary band runs along its north side).
Claypool is 60 ft (y 1012-1102). Wing St runs x 3185-3255. The line at x 3225 south of Claypool is a boundary line, not a street edge.

printed: Denver (street unlabelled here; printed 'DENVER' south of the boundary band)
note: Lockwood Pl (y about 2372-2432 at its west end) runs west from Bowman and ends at the N-S street x about 5652-5718 (house numbers 1251-1263). That street continues south as the street printed DENVER, which I take to be today's Neff.

printed: unlabelled street with streetcar tracks (house numbers 2300-2348)
note: A street with streetcar tracks (x about 5215-5310) comes down from the junction at about 5120,4420 and curves east into W. Eighth (y about 5545-5658, centre 5600). Nothing continues west of the bend. I picked where the leg's centreline meets W. Eighth's centreline. The leg is unlabelled and carries 2300-series numbers like W. Eighth, so taking it as today's Glenway is an inference. W. Eighth's south edge and the SW part of the bend are at the plate's bottom edge. State (with tracks) also crosses W. Eighth at about 5590,5600, which is a different street.
Dutten Ave (y 5181-5257) runs east from State and ends at Depot St (x 6125-6202).
Dutten Ave (y 5180-5255) ends on the east side of State. State, which has streetcar tracks, runs x about 5578-5670 at this point.

printed: ... Street (printed only '...ST.' near 6915,380; '...ACE' further down the same street at about 6745,950)
note: A narrow N-S street (about 42 px wide, slanting SSW, house numbers 1064-1090) ends at W. Liberty (y about 82-160, centre 121). The street's name is not legible in the region. W. Liberty's north edge is the plate's top edge (white above y about 80).

printed: unlabelled leg running SW from the junction where 'WILDER AVE.' ends (about 5120,4420)
Warsaw (printed 'AVE.' on this leg; 'WARSAW' further NW)
note: Switchback: Warsaw (with tracks) comes SE down the leg printed 'AVE.' to a hairpin at about 4930,5150 and turns back NE up the unlabelled leg to the junction circle at about 5120,4420, where WILDER AVE. comes in from the NE. A third leg runs south from the hairpin (centre about 4962 at y 5250) down to the Price Hill Inclined Plane. The pick is the hairpin turn, where Warsaw's centreline meets the NE leg I take to be today's Wilder. The junction at 5120,4420 is another place where today's Wilder and this road system meet.
